brief.claim: In patients whose systolic blood pressure is at least 150 mmHg at entry, the drug lowers systolic pressure by at least 5 mmHg over 12 weeks. The claim holds when the estimated lowering is at least 5 mmHg and one-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: systolic pressure in mmHg at entry (visit 0) and after 12 weeks (visit 1)
True for patients given the drug, False for patients given placebo
